messages:
Jonah Park: Heads-up — TerraBiore hit a supplier delay and only consumed ~6k of their 10k committed units this month. They’re asking for a carveout/credit on the shortfall + a temporary overage discount while they ramp. Can finance/Deal Desk sign off by EOD?

Jonah Park: Context: committed 10k embed units/mo (reserved tier), billed in arrears. Hardware drag meant they launched late and used 6k. Proposed: credit 4k units on this invoice and apply 30% discount to overage charges for next two billing cycles.

Jonah Park: Invoice snippet:```
Invoice: TB-2026-02
Committed units: 10,000
Consumed units: 6,012
List price/unit: $0.12
Shortfall units: 3,988 -> proposed credit = $478.56
Projected overage next cycle (w/discount): TBD
```

Maya Chen: Thanks Jonah. Need to confirm two things: (1) is this a one-time operational relief or do we need an amendment to the contract? (2) Expected churn/risk if we deny?

Jonah Park: (1) They asked for one-time carveout + temporary overage discount; we treat as one-off amendment (no change to committed baseline). (2) Low churn risk, high relationship impact — they’re a strategic life-science platform partner and could expand regionally.

Liam O'Connor: Can we apply the credit retroactively to TB-2026-02 or do we need to issue a separate credit memo? Also need GL code and approval amount.

Maya Chen: Approvals: I can approve up to $5k credit without further escalation. Above that we need VP sign-off. What’s the proposed final credit amount including discounted overage estimate?

Jonah Park: Credit on shortfall = $478.56. Estimated overage discount impact (2 cycles) ~ $3.2k if they hit peak ramp expectations. Combined ~ $3.7k. Under the $5k threshold. Recommend retroactive credit memo for TB-2026-02 $478.56 and a contract addendum to apply 30% discount on overage lines for next 2 invoices.

Elaine Torres: I support this. TerraBiore is in our strategic expansion list — approving conditional carveout makes sense. Please ensure Legal signs the addendum and we capture it in Gainsight. :thumbsup:

Ava (Legal): Please route the proposed addendum. Need the exact wording: start/end dates for discount, whether discount stacks with other promos, and whether credits are refundable or applied only to future invoices.

Jonah Park: Draft language: "One-time credit of $478.56 applied to invoice TB-2026-02. A temporary 30% discount on overage charges for the subsequent two billing cycles starting with invoice TB-2026-03. Discount not combinable with other promotional offers. Credit will be issued as a credit memo and applied to outstanding balance; not refundable." Happy to adjust.

Ava (Legal): That wording looks fine. Please add a sentence requiring the customer to acknowledge acceptance via email for audit trail.

Maya Chen: Okay, with Jonah's numbers and Legal ack, I approve the $478.56 credit memo and the temporary 30% overage discount for two cycles. Liam — please create credit memo and mark GL code 4-210-credits. Apply to TB-2026-02. Also add a note in the invoice comment: "Supply delay carveout — per Deal Desk approval (Maya Chen)."

Liam O'Connor: Will do. Creating CM now and scheduling for next billing run. Ticket created: FIN-4327. finance-bot created FIN-4327

finance-bot: Ticket FIN-4327 created by Liam O'Connor — Credit memo $478.56 for TB-2026-02, GL 4-210-credits. Addendum requested: 30% discount on overage for TB-2026-03 and TB-2026-04 pending customer ack.

Jonah Park: I'll send the addendum to the customer and attach their acceptance email to the ticket. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

Elaine Torres: Great — appreciate the fast response. Keep me posted if the customer asks to extend the discount window.

Maya Chen: Closing note: record this as a one-off operational concession (not precedent). Tag it under Q1 strategic concessions. :white_check_mark:
